answer: One identity seals a kernel of ocean water in a key-bound vial, stakes 80 credits, and logs sector, depth, serial, PSU. Calibrated on a crystal standard of 35 PSU seawater, an auditor checks conductivity against the ocean table. Over 2% off or a serial filed twice forfeits the stake. First filing is 37 credits; the thousandth by one funder is 37+7(k-1)=7,030, so 1,000 forgeries pay 3,533,500 in filing fees, with 80,000 staked. Renting vials fails: one vial serves one identity, and a repeat measurement exposes reuse. A genuine agent files once for 37 and reclaims its stake after a clean epoch.
